question.text: The reason for "drug induced poisoning" is:

options.text: binding irreversibly to the active site of the enzyme.
binding at the allosteric sites of the enzyme.
binding reversibly at the active site of the enzyme.
brining conformational change in the binding site of enzyme.

solution.text: The reason for drug induced poisoning is the binding of drug, irreversibly, to the active site of the enzyme. If this happens, then body degenerates the enzyme and releases a new enzyme.
